annotations.title: Place a snippet on a page

description: Place an InDesign snippet (.idms) on a page, without a helper frame. A snippet built by build_snippet lands at its layout position on that page (position "layout"); position_mm {x, y} puts the top left corner of all its objects there (position "given"); other snippets keep the position stored in them (position "original"). Styles and swatches of the same name: the definition in the document applies; names the document did not have are added and listed under added (paragraph_styles, character_styles, object_styles, swatches) with a warning. A locked layer is refused (invalid_state, details.code layer_locked). Works on parent pages too (is_parent_page). Returns the placed objects (id, type, bounds_mm, page_id, page_name), stories with overset (Übersatz), links with status, missing_fonts and added.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used.

layer.description: Layer (Ebene) for the placed objects. Default: the active layer.

page_id.description: Page to place on, from list_pages or list_parent_pages.

position_mm.description: Top left corner of all placed objects together, in mm from the top left corner of the page. Without it the objects keep their position from the layout (their page position).

name: place_snippet
title: Place a snippet on a page
